pipeline.detail_all_models: Both the primary model and the free fallback have failed (likely due to exhausted credits on both). The pipeline has been aborted. Please top up your OpenRouter account and try again.
pipeline.detail_rate_limit: The AI model returned a rate-limit error (too many requests). Wait a minute and try again.
pipeline.detail_timeout: A step took too long to complete. This is usually transient — retry the pipeline.
pipeline.credit_tip: The primary extraction model returned HTTP 402 (Payment Required). The system automatically switched to the free fallback model. If you see this after the fallback also failed, both OpenRouter accounts are out of credits. Fix: top up at openrouter.ai/credits, then click Try Again.
pipeline.abort_tip: Pipeline aborted. Both the primary model and the free fallback are unavailable. No partial results have been saved. Please restore at least one working LLM before retrying.

landing.hero_heading: ESG Reporting Built for Egyptian Financial Institutions
landing.hero_body: Extract, score, and disclose GRI, FRA, and SASB-aligned ESG metrics from your documents — in minutes, not months.
landing.how_it_works_subheading: From raw Arabic and English documents to a regulator-ready disclosure — handled end-to-end by a multi-model AI pipeline.
landing.pricing_subheading: Transparent pricing built for Egyptian financial institutions. All plans include a 14-day free trial — no credit card required.
landing.vat_note: All prices are VAT-exclusive. Annual plans available at 20% discount.
landing.contact_body: Interested in ESG Catalyst for your institution? We'll walk you through a live demo using your own documents and show you exactly what we extract.
landing.contact_submitted: Thanks! We'll reach out within 24 hours.
landing.bottom_cta_heading: Ready to file your ESG disclosure?
landing.bottom_cta_body: Join Egyptian financial institutions that have moved from manual spreadsheets to automated, auditable ESG reporting.
hero_features: 46 GRI + SASB + FRA indicators scored automatically
AI extraction with per-metric confidence scoring

regulatory_items.title: CBE Sustainable Finance Guidelines
regulatory_items.body: Central Bank of Egypt directive requiring banks to integrate ESG risk into credit decisions and disclosures.

regulatory_items.title: FRA Decree 108/2021
regulatory_items.body: Financial Regulatory Authority mandate requiring ESG disclosure from all listed non-banking financial institutions.

regulatory_items.title: GRI Universal Standards
regulatory_items.body: Global Reporting Initiative 2021 framework — the internationally recognised baseline for ESG disclosures.

steps.title: Upload your documents
steps.body: Arabic and English PDFs, Word, Excel, annual reports, and utility bills. The pipeline reads both languages natively.

steps.title: AI reads & classifies
steps.body: A three-model ensemble flags ESG-relevant passages and sorts each into Environmental, Social, or Governance — across both languages.

steps.title: Metrics extracted with evidence
steps.body: Per-indicator semantic retrieval feeds a language model that pulls structured values, units, and a source citation for each of the 46 GRI, SASB, and FRA indicators.

steps.title: Scored & disclosed
steps.body: Disclosure-quality scoring weighted by sector materiality, then a GRI/FRA-ready PDF and a machine-readable export.

landing.confidence_preview_title: Every metric carries a confidence score
landing.confidence_preview_note: Reviewers see exactly how certain the AI is — so they know what to trust and what to double-check.
